title: Pavement age and condition
intro: A county measured the Pavement Condition Index (PCI, 0 to 100, 100 = new) of twelve road sections resurfaced 1 to 12 years ago. x is the age (years), y the PCI. Read how well the line fits: R², the residual standard error σ̂, the ANOVA F, and the residual plots.
